title: rosa gallica var. atropurpurea
intro: Rosa gallica var. atropurpurea, commonly known as the Dark Red or Purple Gallica Rose, is a variety of the Gallica rose species, known for its deep purple or dark red color and fragrant flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica var. atropurpurea include its antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may aid in wound healing, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
